_provenance.notes: Copper River salmon (especially Chinook and sockeye) command the highest ex-vessel prices of any salmon in the world due to their exceptional fat content from their long river migration. The first commercial opening in mid-May is one of the most-watched events in the US seafood industry. Miles Lake sonar provides real-time escapement counts.
